sentences.text: This section describes turbine control and remote observation during offshore operations.
Vessel AIS Receiver is designated Blue Granite for this operational concept.
Blade Inspection Drone is designated Larkspur for this operational concept.
Duty Planner prepares the Transfer Manifest Addendum to capture approved vessel deployment changes.
Glassfin adjusts turbine output within approved operating limits and blocks commands that conflict with active protection conditions.
Pale Lantern issues forecast updates that support timing decisions for remote observation and field work.
Turbine Controller executes authorized control actions and reports its operating state through established control interfaces.
Pitch System changes blade angle in response to turbine control commands and local protection logic.
Converter Cabinet manages electrical conversion while observing equipment limits and protective interlocks.
Nacelle Condition Monitor provides equipment measurements for ongoing assessment of turbine health.
SCADA Gateway presents turbine status and control availability to authorized shore personnel.
Shore Control Room provides a staffed location for supervisory control and operational review.
Control Engineer reviews alarms and operating conditions before issuing a remote command.
Remote commands are subject to role-based authorization and are recorded for later operational review.
Local protection functions retain priority when remote requests conflict with safe operating limits.
Control availability is checked before remote operation begins and after relevant configuration changes.
Vessel AIS Receiver collects vessel position broadcasts to support marine traffic awareness.
The receiver maintains a time-stamped view of nearby vessel movements when broadcast coverage is available.
Marine Coordinator uses the available traffic picture to support coordination of offshore movements.
Blade Inspection Drone captures close-range visual observations of accessible blade surfaces.
Blade Specialist plans inspection passes to provide consistent coverage of areas selected for examination.
Captured imagery is reviewed for visible surface changes and potential maintenance concerns.
Field Supervisor considers remote observations alongside site conditions before recommending follow-up work.
Drone operation is suspended when weather, visibility, or equipment status makes flight unsafe.
Remote observations supplement field assessment and do not replace required physical inspections.
Maintenance Planning Engine can use reviewed condition information when prioritizing future maintenance activities.
